notes: All nine v0.22 templates filled. Definitions are newly drafted or reused from v0.21/v0.23a; no independent human editorial review yet. Main game untouched. Spelling convention Е can represent Ё in inherited lexicon. Geometry, slot consistency, and uniqueness within each crossword validated.

qa.singular_noun_policy: Words with a normal singular noun form must be singular; inherently plural nouns (e.g. ЧАСЫ, НОЖНИЦЫ, ОБОИ, ГУСЛИ) may remain plural. Automated complete morphology not yet validated.
qa.hint_policy: At most one optional editorial hint per answer. Prefer a direct synonym or another genuine meaning of the same answer. A hint may not contain the answer text, cannot contradict the clue, and must be reviewed before publication.
